author: @marwahaha
source: Derived classical numerical guarantee from the peer-reviewed paper Anshu, Gosset, and Morenz, TQC 2020, Lemma 5 / Eq. (9) (weighted-star upper bound) and Eq. (25), p. 7:10 (matching energy W/2+3m/2), https://doi.org/10.4230/LIPIcs.TQC.2020.7 . The accepted proof combines these published ingredients with a concrete greedy matching and a verified rational Turing-machine implementation. It does not claim to formalize the paper's full 0.53 algorithm. The 0.498 target follows from the verified 1/2 guarantee by monotonicity; it is not a formalization of Gharibian–Parekh's SDP rounding algorithm. For each finite set of true jump times, form the finite set of metric distances over ordered unequal pairs. title: Actual finite-cap stopped signed dividend Stieltjes correction integrable, no separate integrand measurability premise
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave6_04b_finite_cap_actual_stopped_secant_integrable_of_aesm
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave6_04b_original_real_clock_forward_secant_measurable

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- Finite-cap actual stopped signed dividend Stieltjes correction is
integrable without any abstract measurability-of-integrand hypothesis:
real-clock measurability follows from the original source paths and V. -/
theorem AvramDividend.Classical.avram_wave6_04b_finite_cap_actual_stopped_secant_integrable
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C) (hCfinite : C ≠ ⊤)
    (q δ : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {z : ℝ | 0 < z ∧ ENNReal.ofReal z < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
      ENNReal.ofReal z < C → 1 ≤ deriv w z)
    (hVmeas : Measurable V)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ,
      V z = if z ≤ C.toReal then w z
        else w C.toReal + (z - C.toReal))
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hD : IsAdmissibleLe X x C D)

title: All-cap original complete closed-horizon real signed Stieltjes dividend-control inequality
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_positive_cap_original_global_closed_stieltjes_budget
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_dividendStrategy_le_rightLimit

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- Actual complete discounted Stieltjes dividend correction as a signed real inequality, including the zero atom and both cap contacts. -/
theorem solution
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {z : ℝ | 0 < z ∧ ENNReal.ofReal z < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
      ENNReal.ofReal z < C → 1 ≤ deriv w z)
    (hVtop : C = ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ, V z = w z)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ,
      V z = if z ≤ C.toReal then w z
        else w C.toReal + (z - C.toReal))
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hD : IsAdmissibleLe X x C D)
    (ω : Ω) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (hPre : T = 0 ∨ (T : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω) :
    (∫⁻ s in Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ),
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * s))) ∂(dividendMeasure D ω)).toReal +
      (V (x + X.X T ω - rightLimit D T ω) -
        V (x + X.X T ω)) ≤ 0 := by
  have hAdmissible : IsAdmissible X x D := hD.1
  have hStrategy : IsDividendStrategy 𝓕 D := hAdmissible.1
  have hJump := hAdmissible.2 ω T hPre
  have hCover : rightLimit D T ω ≤ x + X.X T ω := by
    dsimp [riskProcess] at hJump
    linarith only [hJump]
  have hDnonneg : 0 ≤ D T ω := by
    have hm := hStrategy.2.1 ω (show (0 : ℝ≥0) ≤ T from zero_le)
    simpa only [hStrategy.1 ω] using hm
  have hRightNonneg : 0 ≤ rightLimit D T ω := le_trans hDnonneg
    (dividendStrategy_le_rightLimit D hStrategy ω T)
  have hOrder : x + X.X T ω - rightLimit D T ω ≤ x + X.X T ω := by
    linarith only [hRightNonneg]
  have hSec := avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant
    C hC w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVtop hVfinite
    (x + X.X T ω - rightLimit D T ω) (x + X.X T ω)
    (sub_nonneg.mpr hCover) hOrder
  have hDropNonneg : 0 ≤
      V (x + X.X T ω) -
        V (x + X.X T ω - rightLimit D T ω) := by
    linarith only [hSec, hRightNonneg]
  have hBudget := avram_wave5_04b_positive_cap_original_global_closed_stieltjes_budget
    X x C hC q hq w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVtop hVfinite
    D hD ω T hPre
  have hReal := ENNReal.toReal_mono (by simp) hBudget
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hDropNonneg] at hReal
  linarith only [hReal]

title: Canonical original real-clock countable signed right-payment correction without hloc
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal BigOperators
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- The real-clock absolutely summable countable chronological right-payment signed correction is nonpositive at every boundary and at time zero. -/
theorem solution
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕) (x : ℝ)
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ω : Ω) (q : ℝ)
    (hjump : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      (t = 0 ∨ (t : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω) →
      rightLimit D t ω - D t ω ≤
        w (riskProcess X x D t ω) -
          w (riskProcess X x D t ω -
            (rightLimit D t ω - D t ω)))
    (A : Set ℝ) (hCount : A.Countable)
    (hNonneg : ∀ t : A, 0 ≤ (t : ℝ))
    (hA : ∀ t : A,
      ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) = 0 ∨
        (((t : ℝ).toNNReal) : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω)
    (hSummable : Summable (fun t : A => Real.exp (-(q * (t : ℝ))) *
      ((rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω) +
        w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω -
          (rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)) -
        w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)))) :
    (∑' t : A, Real.exp (-(q * (t : ℝ))) *
      ((rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω) +
        w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω -
          (rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)) -
        w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω))) ≤ 0 := by
  apply tsum_nonpos
  intro t
  have hDrop := hjump ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) (hA t)
  have hResidual :
      (rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω) +
        w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω -
          (rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)) -
        w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω) ≤ 0 := by
    linarith only [hDrop]
  exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Real.exp_pos _).le hResidual

title: Countably many original right-payment signed corrections have zero positive mass at all reserve contacts
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal BigOperators
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- Every positive part of the entire countable chronological right-payment signed correction vanishes, without a summability or reserve-interior hypothesis. -/
theorem solution
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕) (x : ℝ)
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ω : Ω) (q : ℝ)
    (hjump : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      (t = 0 ∨ (t : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω) →
      rightLimit D t ω - D t ω ≤
        w (riskProcess X x D t ω) -
          w (riskProcess X x D t ω -
            (rightLimit D t ω - D t ω)))
    (A : Set ℝ≥0) (hCount : A.Countable)
    (hA : ∀ t : A,
      (t : ℝ≥0) = 0 ∨
        ((t : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω) :
    (∑' t : A, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * ((t : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))) *
      ((rightLimit D (t : ℝ≥0) ω - D (t : ℝ≥0) ω) +
        w (riskProcess X x D (t : ℝ≥0) ω -
          (rightLimit D (t : ℝ≥0) ω - D (t : ℝ≥0) ω)) -
        w (riskProcess X x D (t : ℝ≥0) ω)))) = 0 := by
  have hZero : ∀ t : A, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * ((t : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))) *
      ((rightLimit D (t : ℝ≥0) ω - D (t : ℝ≥0) ω) +
        w (riskProcess X x D (t : ℝ≥0) ω -
          (rightLimit D (t : ℝ≥0) ω - D (t : ℝ≥0) ω)) -
        w (riskProcess X x D (t : ℝ≥0) ω))) = 0 := by
    intro t
    have hDrop := hjump (t : ℝ≥0) (hA t)
    have hResidual :
        (rightLimit D (t : ℝ≥0) ω - D (t : ℝ≥0) ω) +
          w (riskProcess X x D (t : ℝ≥0) ω -
            (rightLimit D (t : ℝ≥0) ω - D (t : ℝ≥0) ω)) -
          w (riskProcess X x D (t : ℝ≥0) ω) ≤ 0 := by
      linarith only [hDrop]
    have hProduct : Real.exp (-(q * ((t : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))) *
        ((rightLimit D (t : ℝ≥0) ω - D (t : ℝ≥0) ω) +
          w (riskProcess X x D (t : ℝ≥0) ω -
            (rightLimit D (t : ℝ≥0) ω - D (t : ℝ≥0) ω)) -
          w (riskProcess X x D (t : ℝ≥0) ω)) ≤ 0 :=
      mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Real.exp_pos _).le hResidual
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr hProduct
  simp only [hZero, tsum_zero]

title: Direct source-specific no-summability global signed Stieltjes plus countable jump positive parts
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_positive_cap_original_global_closed_horizon_real_signed_nonpos

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal BigOperators
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- Summability-free real-clock joint nonpositive control of the complete actual closed-horizon Stieltjes mass and the absolutely summable countable explicit-w right-payment correction, with no reserve-interior localisation. -/
theorem solution
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {z : ℝ | 0 < z ∧ ENNReal.ofReal z < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
      ENNReal.ofReal z < C → 1 ≤ deriv w z)
    (hVtop : C = ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ, V z = w z)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ,
      V z = if z ≤ C.toReal then w z
        else w C.toReal + (z - C.toReal))
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hD : IsAdmissibleLe X x C D)
    (ω : Ω) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (hPre : T = 0 ∨ (T : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω)
    (hjump : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      (t = 0 ∨ (t : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω) →
      rightLimit D t ω - D t ω ≤
        w (riskProcess X x D t ω) -
          w (riskProcess X x D t ω -
            (rightLimit D t ω - D t ω)))
    (A : Set ℝ) (hCount : A.Countable)
    (hNonneg : ∀ t : A, 0 ≤ (t : ℝ))
    (hA : ∀ t : A,
      ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) = 0 ∨
        (((t : ℝ).toNNReal) : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω)
    : ((∫⁻ s in Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ),
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * s))) ∂(dividendMeasure D ω)).toReal +
      (V (x + X.X T ω - rightLimit D T ω) -
        V (x + X.X T ω))) +
    (∑' t : A, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * (t : ℝ))) *
      ((rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω) +
        w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω -
          (rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)) -
        w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)))).toReal ≤ 0 := by
  have hContinuous := avram_wave5_04b_positive_cap_original_global_closed_horizon_real_signed_nonpos
    X x C hC q hq w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVtop hVfinite
    D hD ω T hPre
  have hTerm : ∀ t : A, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * (t : ℝ))) *
      ((rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω) +
        w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω -
          (rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)) -
        w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω))) = 0 := by
    intro t
    have hDrop := hjump ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) (hA t)
    have hResidual :
        (rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω) +
          w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω -
            (rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)) -
          w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω) ≤ 0 := by
      linarith only [hDrop]
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Real.exp_pos _).le hResidual
  have hZero : (∑' t : A, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * (t : ℝ))) *
      ((rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω) +
        w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω -
          (rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)) -
        w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)))) = 0 := by
    simp [hTerm]
  simpa [hZero] using hContinuous

title: Lifetime actual ruin-stopped dividend measure forward secant positive-part integral zero
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_paymentTimes_measurable

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- For the entire lifetime ruin-stopped reward region, the actual dividend
measure of the positive part of the signed forward-secant correction is zero,
including singular-continuous and time-zero dividend variation. -/
theorem solution
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C)
    (q δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {z : ℝ | 0 < z ∧ ENNReal.ofReal z < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
      ENNReal.ofReal z < C → 1 ≤ deriv w z)
    (hVtop : C = ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ, V z = w z)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ,
      V z = if z ≤ C.toReal then w z
        else w C.toReal + (z - C.toReal))
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hD : IsAdmissibleLe X x C D)
    (ω : Ω)
    : (∫⁻ s in paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω),
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) -
          V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ))) ∂(dividendMeasure D ω)) = 0 := by
  have hPoint : ∀ s : ℝ, s ∈ paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω) →
      Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) - V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)) ≤ 0 := by
    intro s hs
    have hsPay := hs.1
    change s ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ) ∩
      ({0} ∪ {t : ℝ | ENNReal.ofReal t < ruinTime X x D ω}) at hsPay
    have hPreS : s.toNNReal = 0 ∨
        (s.toNNReal : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω := by
      rcases hsPay.2 with hzero | hlt
      · left
        have heq : s = 0 := by simpa using hzero
        simp only [heq, Real.toNNReal_zero]
      · right
        change (s.toNNReal : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω at hlt
        exact hlt
    have hAdmissible : IsAdmissible X x D := hD.1
    have hCover := hAdmissible.2 ω s.toNNReal hPreS
    dsimp [riskProcess] at hCover
    let y : ℝ := x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω
    have hy : 0 ≤ y := by linarith only [hCover]
    have hOrder : y ≤ y + δ := le_add_of_nonneg_right hδ.le
    have hSec := avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant
      C hC w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVtop hVfinite
      y (y + δ) hy hOrder
    have hResidual : δ + V y - V (y + δ) ≤ 0 := by
      linarith only [hSec]
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Real.exp_pos _).le hResidual
  have hTerm : ∀ s : ℝ,
      s ∈ paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω) →
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) -
          V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ))) = 0 := by
    intro s hs
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr (hPoint s hs)
  calc
    (∫⁻ s in paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω),
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) -
          V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ))) ∂(dividendMeasure D ω))
      = (∫⁻ s in paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω),
          (0 : ℝ≥0∞) ∂(dividendMeasure D ω)) := by
            apply MeasureTheory.lintegral_congr_ae
            filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem
              (paymentTimes_measurable _)] with s hs
            exact hTerm s hs
    _ = 0 := by simp

title: Original-source finite right-payment signed dividend correction without boundary localisation
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal BigOperators
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- Arbitrary finite chronological right-payment corrections are nonpositive, including time zero and payments with pre-payment reserve above the cap. -/
theorem solution
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕) (x : ℝ)
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ω : Ω) (q : ℝ)
    (hjump : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      (t = 0 ∨ (t : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω) →
      rightLimit D t ω - D t ω ≤
        w (riskProcess X x D t ω) -
          w (riskProcess X x D t ω -
            (rightLimit D t ω - D t ω)))
    (F : Finset ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ∀ t ∈ F,
      t = 0 ∨ (t : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω) :
    (∑ t ∈ F, Real.exp (-(q * (t : ℝ))) *
      ((rightLimit D t ω - D t ω) +
        w (riskProcess X x D t ω -
          (rightLimit D t ω - D t ω)) -
        w (riskProcess X x D t ω))) ≤ 0 := by
  apply Finset.sum_nonpos
  intro t ht
  have hDrop := hjump t (hF t ht)
  have hResidual :
      (rightLimit D t ω - D t ω) +
        w (riskProcess X x D t ω -
          (rightLimit D t ω - D t ω)) -
        w (riskProcess X x D t ω) ≤ 0 := by
    linarith only [hDrop]
  exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Real.exp_pos _).le hResidual

title: Genuine finite-cap stopped signed dividend Stieltjes integral finite and nonpositive, full actual measure
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave6_04b_finite_cap_actual_stopped_secant_integrable_closed
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave6_04b_allcap_actual_real_clock_forward_secant_nonpos
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_paymentTimes_measurable

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- The exact original stopped actual dividend Stieltjes integral is a
genuine finite signed integral and is nonpositive on the full payment set,
including the zero atom, singular-continuous variation and all cap contacts. -/
theorem AvramDividend.Classical.avram_wave6_04b_finite_cap_actual_stopped_signed_stieltjes_integral_nonpos
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C) (hCfinite : C ≠ ⊤)
    (q δ : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {z : ℝ | 0 < z ∧ ENNReal.ofReal z < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
      ENNReal.ofReal z < C → 1 ≤ deriv w z)
    (hw_neg : ∀ y : ℝ, y < 0 → w y = 0)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ,
      V z = if z ≤ C.toReal then w z
        else w C.toReal + (z - C.toReal))
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hD : IsAdmissibleLe X x C D)
    (ω : Ω) (T : ℝ≥0) :
    IntegrableOn (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
      (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) -
        V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)))
      (paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω) ∩ Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ))
      (dividendMeasure D ω) ∧
    (∫ s : ℝ, Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
      (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) -
        V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ))
        ∂((dividendMeasure D ω).restrict
          (paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω) ∩ Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ)))) ≤ 0 := by
  constructor
  · exact avram_wave6_04b_finite_cap_actual_stopped_secant_integrable_closed
      X x C hC hCfinite q δ hq hδ w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad
      hw_neg hVfinite D hD ω T
  · have hAmeas : MeasurableSet
        (paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω) ∩ Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ)) :=
      (paymentTimes_measurable _).inter measurableSet_Icc
    have hVtop : C = ⊤ → ∀ y : ℝ, V y = w y :=
      fun htop => (hCfinite htop).elim
    apply integral_nonpos_of_ae
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem hAmeas] with s hs
    exact avram_wave6_04b_allcap_actual_real_clock_forward_secant_nonpos
      X x C hC q δ hδ w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad
      hVtop hVfinite D hD ω s hs.1

title: Original admissible capped dividend actual signed Stieltjes forward secant without hloc
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_closed_preruin_actual_postpayment_solvency
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_solvent_actual_stieltjes_forward_secant_real_signed_nonpos

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal

open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- For genuinely admissible original source-X dividends, the actual real
Stieltjes signed forward-secant correction is nonpositive on the full closed
horizon, including boundary contacts and singular-continuous variation. -/
theorem solution
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C)
    (q δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {z : ℝ | 0 < z ∧ ENNReal.ofReal z < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
      ENNReal.ofReal z < C → 1 ≤ deriv w z)
    (hVtop : C = ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ, V z = w z)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ,
      V z = if z ≤ C.toReal then w z
        else w C.toReal + (z - C.toReal))
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hD : IsAdmissibleLe X x C D)
    (ω : Ω) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (hPre : T = 0 ∨ (T : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω)
    (hIntegrable : IntegrableOn (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) - V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)))
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ)) (dividendMeasure D ω)) :
    (∫ s in Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ),
      Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) - V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)) ∂(dividendMeasure D ω)) ≤ 0 := by
  have hSolvent := avram_wave5_04b_closed_preruin_actual_postpayment_solvency
    X x C D hD ω T hPre
  exact avram_wave5_04b_solvent_actual_stieltjes_forward_secant_real_signed_nonpos
    X x C hC q δ hδ w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVtop hVfinite
    D ω T hSolvent hIntegrable

title: Actual post-payment Lévy reserve is measurable on real Stieltjes time
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_postPaymentReserve_cadlag_adapted
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_rightContinuous_measurable_sections_joint_evaluation

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- The original controlled post-payment reserve is Borel-measurable
as a real-clock path, including the negative-time toNNReal convention. -/
theorem AvramDividend.Classical.avram_wave6_04b_original_real_clock_postpayment_reserve_measurable
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hD : IsDividendStrategy 𝓕 D) (ω : Ω) :
    Measurable (fun s : ℝ =>
      x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) := by
  have hp := postPaymentReserve_cadlag_adapted X x D hD
  let F : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ := fun t ω =>
    x + X.X t ω - rightLimit D t ω
  have hsections (t : ℝ≥0) : Measurable (F t) := by
    exact (hp.2.2 t).mono (𝓕.rightCont.le t) le_rfl
  have hright : ∀ ω t, ContinuousWithinAt
      (fun s : ℝ≥0 => F s ω) (Ici t) t := by
    intro ω t
    exact hp.1 ω t
  have hjoint : Measurable (fun z : ℝ≥0 × Ω => F z.1 z.2) :=
    rightContinuous_measurable_sections_joint_evaluation F hsections hright
  have hslice : Measurable (fun t : ℝ≥0 => F t ω) := by
    exact hjoint.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)
  have hclock : Measurable (fun s : ℝ => s.toNNReal) :=
    Real.toNNReal_mono.measurable
  exact hslice.comp hclock

title: No-summability actual global Stieltjes and real-clock right-jump positive-parts estimate
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_positive_cap_original_global_closed_horizon_real_signed_nonpos
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_real_clock_countable_right_positive_part_zero

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal BigOperators
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- Summability-free real-clock joint nonpositive control of the complete actual closed-horizon Stieltjes mass and the absolutely summable countable explicit-w right-payment correction, with no reserve-interior localisation. -/
theorem solution
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {z : ℝ | 0 < z ∧ ENNReal.ofReal z < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
      ENNReal.ofReal z < C → 1 ≤ deriv w z)
    (hVtop : C = ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ, V z = w z)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ,
      V z = if z ≤ C.toReal then w z
        else w C.toReal + (z - C.toReal))
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hD : IsAdmissibleLe X x C D)
    (ω : Ω) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (hPre : T = 0 ∨ (T : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω)
    (hjump : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      (t = 0 ∨ (t : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω) →
      rightLimit D t ω - D t ω ≤
        w (riskProcess X x D t ω) -
          w (riskProcess X x D t ω -
            (rightLimit D t ω - D t ω)))
    (A : Set ℝ) (hCount : A.Countable)
    (hNonneg : ∀ t : A, 0 ≤ (t : ℝ))
    (hA : ∀ t : A,
      ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) = 0 ∨
        (((t : ℝ).toNNReal) : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω)
    : ((∫⁻ s in Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ),
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * s))) ∂(dividendMeasure D ω)).toReal +
      (V (x + X.X T ω - rightLimit D T ω) -
        V (x + X.X T ω))) +
    (∑' t : A, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * (t : ℝ))) *
      ((rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω) +
        w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω -
          (rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)) -
        w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)))).toReal ≤ 0 := by
  have hContinuous := avram_wave5_04b_positive_cap_original_global_closed_horizon_real_signed_nonpos
    X x C hC q hq w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVtop hVfinite
    D hD ω T hPre
  have hRightJumps := avram_wave5_04b_real_clock_countable_right_positive_part_zero
    X x D w ω q hjump A hCount hNonneg hA
  simpa [hRightJumps] using hContinuous

title: Cap-linear HJB extension is Borel measurable with zero-negative candidate
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- The cap-linear extension of a nonnegative-side continuous HJB candidate,
zero on negative capital, is Borel measurable for every finite/infinite cap. -/
theorem AvramDividend.Classical.avram_wave6_04b_cap_extension_measurable_of_zero_negative
    (w V : ℝ → ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_neg : ∀ y : ℝ, y < 0 → w y = 0)
    (hVtop : C = ⊤ → ∀ y : ℝ, V y = w y)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ y : ℝ,
      V y = if y ≤ C.toReal then w y
        else w C.toReal + (y - C.toReal)) :
    Measurable V := by
  have hwPiece : Measurable
      ((Ici (0 : ℝ)).piecewise w (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) :=
    hw_cont.measurable_piecewise continuous_const.continuousOn
      measurableSet_Ici
  have hwEq : (Ici (0 : ℝ)).piecewise w (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) = w := by
    funext y
    by_cases hy : 0 ≤ y
    · simp [Set.piecewise, Set.mem_Ici, hy]
    · have hlt : y < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hy
      simp [Set.piecewise, Set.mem_Ici, hy, hw_neg y hlt]
  have hwMeas : Measurable w := by
    rw [← hwEq]
    exact hwPiece
  by_cases htop : C = ⊤
  · have hVeq : V = w := by
      funext y
      exact hVtop htop y
    rw [hVeq]
    exact hwMeas
  · have hLin : Measurable (fun y : ℝ =>
        w C.toReal + (y - C.toReal)) :=
      measurable_const.add (measurable_id.sub measurable_const)
    have hPiece : Measurable
        ((Iic C.toReal).piecewise w
          (fun y : ℝ => w C.toReal + (y - C.toReal))) :=
      hwMeas.piecewise hLin measurableSet_Iic
    have hVeq : V = (Iic C.toReal).piecewise w
        (fun y : ℝ => w C.toReal + (y - C.toReal)) := by
      funext y
      rw [hVfinite htop y]
      simp [Set.piecewise, Set.mem_Iic]
    rw [hVeq]
    exact hPiece

title: Lifetime original actual signed Stieltjes forward secant on ruin-stopped payments without hloc
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_paymentTimes_measurable

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- Over all lifetime ruin-stopped payment times, the signed real forward
secant Stieltjes correction is nonpositive whenever integrable, including
zero/cap contacts, timezero, and singular-continuous variation. -/
theorem solution
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C)
    (q δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {z : ℝ | 0 < z ∧ ENNReal.ofReal z < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
      ENNReal.ofReal z < C → 1 ≤ deriv w z)
    (hVtop : C = ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ, V z = w z)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ,
      V z = if z ≤ C.toReal then w z
        else w C.toReal + (z - C.toReal))
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hD : IsAdmissibleLe X x C D)
    (ω : Ω)
    (hIntegrable : IntegrableOn (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) - V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)))
      (paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω)) (dividendMeasure D ω)) :
    (∫ s in paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω),
      Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) - V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)) ∂(dividendMeasure D ω)) ≤ 0 := by
  have hPoint : ∀ s : ℝ, s ∈ paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω) →
      Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) - V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)) ≤ 0 := by
    intro s hs
    have hsPay := hs.1
    change s ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ) ∩
      ({0} ∪ {t : ℝ | ENNReal.ofReal t < ruinTime X x D ω}) at hsPay
    have hPreS : s.toNNReal = 0 ∨
        (s.toNNReal : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω := by
      rcases hsPay.2 with hzero | hlt
      · left
        have heq : s = 0 := by simpa using hzero
        simp only [heq, Real.toNNReal_zero]
      · right
        change (s.toNNReal : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω at hlt
        exact hlt
    have hAdmissible : IsAdmissible X x D := hD.1
    have hCover := hAdmissible.2 ω s.toNNReal hPreS
    dsimp [riskProcess] at hCover
    let y : ℝ := x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω
    have hy : 0 ≤ y := by linarith only [hCover]
    have hOrder : y ≤ y + δ := le_add_of_nonneg_right hδ.le
    have hSec := avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant
      C hC w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVtop hVfinite
      y (y + δ) hy hOrder
    have hResidual : δ + V y - V (y + δ) ≤ 0 := by
      linarith only [hSec]
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Real.exp_pos _).le hResidual
  apply MeasureTheory.integral_nonpos_of_ae
  filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem
    (paymentTimes_measurable _)] with s hs
  exact hPoint s hs

title: Every countable real-clock original right-payment positive correction vanishes without summability
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal BigOperators
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- The countable real-clock positive part of all chronological right-payment signed corrections vanishes, with no summability condition. -/
theorem solution
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕) (x : ℝ)
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ω : Ω) (q : ℝ)
    (hjump : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      (t = 0 ∨ (t : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω) →
      rightLimit D t ω - D t ω ≤
        w (riskProcess X x D t ω) -
          w (riskProcess X x D t ω -
            (rightLimit D t ω - D t ω)))
    (A : Set ℝ) (hCount : A.Countable)
    (hNonneg : ∀ t : A, 0 ≤ (t : ℝ))
    (hA : ∀ t : A,
      ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) = 0 ∨
        (((t : ℝ).toNNReal) : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω)
    : (∑' t : A, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * (t : ℝ))) *
      ((rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω) +
        w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω -
          (rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)) -
        w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)))) = 0 := by
  have hTerm : ∀ t : A, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * (t : ℝ))) *
      ((rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω) +
        w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω -
          (rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)) -
        w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω))) = 0 := by
    intro t
    have hDrop := hjump ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) (hA t)
    have hResidual :
        (rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω) +
          w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω -
            (rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)) -
          w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω) ≤ 0 := by
      linarith only [hDrop]
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Real.exp_pos _).le hResidual
  simp [hTerm]

title: Finite-cap uniform magnitude bound for actual stopped Stieltjes secant control
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_finite_cap_uniform_dividend_secant_residual_bound

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- The actual finite-cap dividend secant has bounded discounted norm
at every stopped payment time, including all boundary and atom contacts. -/
theorem AvramDividend.Classical.avram_wave6_04b_finite_cap_actual_stopped_secant_uniform_point_bound
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C) (hCfinite : C ≠ ⊤)
    (q δ : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {z : ℝ | 0 < z ∧ ENNReal.ofReal z < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
      ENNReal.ofReal z < C → 1 ≤ deriv w z)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ,
      V z = if z ≤ C.toReal then w z
        else w C.toReal + (z - C.toReal))
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hD : IsAdmissibleLe X x C D)
    (ω : Ω) (s : ℝ)
    (hs : s ∈ paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω)) :
    ‖Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
      (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) -
        V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ))‖ ≤
      (w C.toReal - C.toReal) - w 0 := by
  have hsPay := hs
  change s ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ) ∩
    ({0} ∪ {t : ℝ | ENNReal.ofReal t < ruinTime X x D ω}) at hsPay
  have hPreS : s.toNNReal = 0 ∨
      (s.toNNReal : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω := by
    rcases hsPay.2 with hzero | hlt
    · left
      have heq : s = 0 := by simpa using hzero
      simp only [heq, Real.toNNReal_zero]
    · right
      change (s.toNNReal : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω at hlt
      exact hlt
  have hCover := hD.1.2 ω s.toNNReal hPreS
  dsimp [riskProcess] at hCover
  let y : ℝ := x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω
  have hy : 0 ≤ y := by linarith only [hCover]
  have hSec := avram_wave5_04b_finite_cap_uniform_dividend_secant_residual_bound
    C hC hCfinite w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVfinite
    y δ hy hδ
  let R : ℝ := δ + V y - V (y + δ)
  let L : ℝ := (w C.toReal - C.toReal) - w 0
  have hRhi : R ≤ 0 := by
    dsimp [R]
    linarith only [hSec.1]
  have hRlo : -L ≤ R := by
    dsimp [R, L]
    linarith only [hSec.2]
  have hExpLe : Real.exp (-(q * s)) ≤ 1 := by
    have hn : -(q * s) ≤ (0 : ℝ) :=
      neg_nonpos.mpr (mul_nonneg hq hsPay.1)
    simpa using (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hn)
  have hAbs : |Real.exp (-(q * s)) * R| =
      Real.exp (-(q * s)) * (-R) := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), abs_of_nonpos hRhi]
    ring
  change |Real.exp (-(q * s)) * R| ≤ L
  rw [hAbs]
  calc
    Real.exp (-(q * s)) * (-R) ≤ 1 * (-R) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hExpLe (neg_nonneg.mpr hRhi)
    _ = -R := by ring
    _ ≤ L := by linarith only [hRlo]

title: All-positive-cap signed actual real-clock forward secant nonpositive at every stopped dividend payment time
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- At every genuine ruin-stopped payment time, including reserve zero,
cap contact and the time-zero atom, the actual post-payment forward secant
is nonpositive for finite OR infinite positive caps. -/
theorem AvramDividend.Classical.avram_wave6_04b_allcap_actual_real_clock_forward_secant_nonpos
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C)
    (q δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {z : ℝ | 0 < z ∧ ENNReal.ofReal z < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
      ENNReal.ofReal z < C → 1 ≤ deriv w z)
    (hVtop : C = ⊤ → ∀ y : ℝ, V y = w y)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ y : ℝ,
      V y = if y ≤ C.toReal then w y
        else w C.toReal + (y - C.toReal))
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hD : IsAdmissibleLe X x C D)
    (ω : Ω) (s : ℝ)
    (hs : s ∈ paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω)) :
    Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
      (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) -
        V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ))
      ≤ 0 := by
  have hsPay := hs
  change s ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ) ∩
    ({0} ∪ {t : ℝ | ENNReal.ofReal t < ruinTime X x D ω}) at hsPay
  have hPreS : s.toNNReal = 0 ∨
      (s.toNNReal : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω := by
    rcases hsPay.2 with hzero | hlt
    · left
      have heq : s = 0 := by simpa using hzero
      simp only [heq, Real.toNNReal_zero]
    · right
      change (s.toNNReal : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω at hlt
      exact hlt
  have hCover := hD.1.2 ω s.toNNReal hPreS
  dsimp [riskProcess] at hCover
  let y : ℝ := x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω
  have hy : 0 ≤ y := by linarith only [hCover]
  have horder : y ≤ y + δ := le_add_of_nonneg_right hδ
  have hSec := avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant
    C hC w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVtop hVfinite
    y (y + δ) hy horder
  have hR : δ + V y - V (y + δ) ≤ 0 := by
    dsimp [y] at hSec ⊢
    linarith only [hSec]
  change Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
    (δ + V y - V (y + δ)) ≤ 0
  exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Real.exp_pos _).le hR

title: Cap-linear extension equals original supersolution on the full closed capped interval
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- The cap-linear value extension agrees with the candidate at every closed-cap postpayment state, including zero and the cap. -/
theorem solution
    (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C) (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hVtop : C = ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ, V z = w z)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ,
      V z = if z ≤ C.toReal then w z
        else w C.toReal + (z - C.toReal))
    (z : ℝ) (hz0 : 0 ≤ z) (hzC : ENNReal.ofReal z ≤ C) :
    V z = w z := by
  by_cases htop : C = ⊤
  · exact hVtop htop z
  · have hReal : z ≤ C.toReal := by
      have h := ENNReal.toReal_mono htop hzC
      rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hz0] at h
      exact h
    rw [hVfinite htop z]
    exact if_pos hReal

title: Original real-clock full Stieltjes and countable right-jump signed estimate without hloc
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_positive_cap_original_global_closed_horizon_real_signed_nonpos
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_original_real_clock_countable_right_signed_sum_nonpos

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal BigOperators
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- Real-clock joint signed control of the complete actual closed-horizon Stieltjes mass and the absolutely summable countable explicit-w right-payment correction, with no reserve-interior localisation. -/
theorem solution
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {z : ℝ | 0 < z ∧ ENNReal.ofReal z < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
      ENNReal.ofReal z < C → 1 ≤ deriv w z)
    (hVtop : C = ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ, V z = w z)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ,
      V z = if z ≤ C.toReal then w z
        else w C.toReal + (z - C.toReal))
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hD : IsAdmissibleLe X x C D)
    (ω : Ω) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (hPre : T = 0 ∨ (T : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω)
    (hjump : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      (t = 0 ∨ (t : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω) →
      rightLimit D t ω - D t ω ≤
        w (riskProcess X x D t ω) -
          w (riskProcess X x D t ω -
            (rightLimit D t ω - D t ω)))
    (A : Set ℝ) (hCount : A.Countable)
    (hNonneg : ∀ t : A, 0 ≤ (t : ℝ))
    (hA : ∀ t : A,
      ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) = 0 ∨
        (((t : ℝ).toNNReal) : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω)
    (hSummable : Summable (fun t : A => Real.exp (-(q * (t : ℝ))) *
      ((rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω) +
        w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω -
          (rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)) -
        w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)))) :
    ((∫⁻ s in Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ),
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * s))) ∂(dividendMeasure D ω)).toReal +
      (V (x + X.X T ω - rightLimit D T ω) -
        V (x + X.X T ω))) +
    (∑' t : A, Real.exp (-(q * (t : ℝ))) *
      ((rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω) +
        w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω -
          (rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω - D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)) -
        w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω))) ≤ 0 := by
  have hContinuous := avram_wave5_04b_positive_cap_original_global_closed_horizon_real_signed_nonpos
    X x C hC q hq w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVtop hVfinite
    D hD ω T hPre
  have hRightJumps := avram_wave5_04b_original_real_clock_countable_right_signed_sum_nonpos
    X x D w ω q hjump A hCount hNonneg hA hSummable
  linarith only [hContinuous, hRightJumps]

title: Automatic finite-cap actual Stieltjes forward-secant integrability from time measurability
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_finite_cap_uniform_dividend_secant_residual_bound
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave3_03_dividendMeasure_Icc_zero_eq_rightLimit
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_paymentTimes_measurable

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- On any actual stopped finite dividend measure, the cap-linear forward
secant correction is automatically L1 once its time measurability is known.
Finite cap bounds the residual, and the genuine Stieltjes measure has finite
closed-horizon mass including the singular-continuous and zero atoms. -/
theorem AvramDividend.Classical.avram_wave6_04b_finite_cap_actual_stopped_secant_integrable_of_aesm
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C) (hCfinite : C ≠ ⊤)
    (q δ : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {z : ℝ | 0 < z ∧ ENNReal.ofReal z < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
      ENNReal.ofReal z < C → 1 ≤ deriv w z)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ,
      V z = if z ≤ C.toReal then w z
        else w C.toReal + (z - C.toReal))
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hD : IsAdmissibleLe X x C D)
    (ω : Ω) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (hMeas : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
      (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) -
        V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)))
      ((dividendMeasure D ω).restrict (paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω) ∩ Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ)))) :
    IntegrableOn (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
      (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) -
        V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)))
      (paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω) ∩ Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ)) (dividendMeasure D ω) := by
  let A : Set ℝ :=
    paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω) ∩ Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ)
  let μ : Measure ℝ := (dividendMeasure D ω).restrict A
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun s =>
    Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
      (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) -
        V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ))
  let L : ℝ := (w C.toReal - C.toReal) - w 0
  have hAmeas : MeasurableSet A :=
    (paymentTimes_measurable _).inter measurableSet_Icc
  have hA_sub : A ⊆ Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ) := by
    intro s hs
    exact hs.2
  have hstrategy : IsDividendStrategy 𝓕 D := hD.1.1
  have hμfinite : μ Set.univ < ⊤ := by
    calc
      μ Set.univ = (dividendMeasure D ω) A := by simp [μ]
      _ ≤ (dividendMeasure D ω) (Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ)) :=
        measure_mono hA_sub
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (rightLimit D T ω) :=
        avram_wave3_03_dividendMeasure_Icc_zero_eq_rightLimit D hstrategy ω T
      _ < ⊤ := ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  letI : IsFiniteMeasure μ := (isFiniteMeasure_iff μ).2 hμfinite
  have hBound : ∀ s : ℝ, s ∈ A → ‖f s‖ ≤ L := by
    intro s hs
    have hsPay := hs.1
    change s ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ) ∩
      ({0} ∪ {t : ℝ | ENNReal.ofReal t < ruinTime X x D ω}) at hsPay
    have hPreS : s.toNNReal = 0 ∨
        (s.toNNReal : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω := by
      rcases hsPay.2 with hzero | hlt
      · left
        have heq : s = 0 := by simpa using hzero
        simp only [heq, Real.toNNReal_zero]
      · right
        change (s.toNNReal : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω at hlt
        exact hlt
    have hCover := hD.1.2 ω s.toNNReal hPreS
    dsimp [riskProcess] at hCover
    let y : ℝ := x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω
    have hy : 0 ≤ y := by linarith only [hCover]
    have hSec := avram_wave5_04b_finite_cap_uniform_dividend_secant_residual_bound
      C hC hCfinite w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVfinite
      y δ hy hδ
    let R : ℝ := δ + V y - V (y + δ)
    have hRhi : R ≤ 0 := by
      dsimp [R]
      linarith only [hSec.1]
    have hRlo : -L ≤ R := by
      dsimp [R, L]
      linarith only [hSec.2]
    have hExpLe : Real.exp (-(q * s)) ≤ 1 := by
      have hn : -(q * s) ≤ (0 : ℝ) :=
        neg_nonpos.mpr (mul_nonneg hq hsPay.1)
      simpa using (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hn)
    have hAbs : |Real.exp (-(q * s)) * R| =
        Real.exp (-(q * s)) * (-R) := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), abs_of_nonpos hRhi]
      ring
    change |Real.exp (-(q * s)) * R| ≤ L
    rw [hAbs]
    calc
      Real.exp (-(q * s)) * (-R) ≤ 1 * (-R) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hExpLe (neg_nonneg.mpr hRhi)
      _ = -R := by ring
      _ ≤ L := by linarith only [hRlo]
  change Integrable f μ
  have hAES : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ := hMeas
  apply Integrable.of_bound hAES L
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem hAmeas] with s hs
  exact hBound s hs

title: All-cap actual right-payment positive-part sum vanishes without hjump or summability
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave6_04b_allcap_actual_right_payment_secant_nonpos

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal BigOperators
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- All chronological actual right-dividend V-corrections have zero
discounted ENNReal positive-part tsum for arbitrary stopped real-clock sets.
This includes the countable atom support, time zero and boundary contacts. -/
theorem AvramDividend.Classical.avram_wave6_04b_allcap_actual_countable_right_payment_positivepart_zero
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C) (q : ℝ)
    (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {y : ℝ | 0 < y ∧ ENNReal.ofReal y < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y →
      ENNReal.ofReal y < C → 1 ≤ deriv w y)
    (hVtop : C = ⊤ → ∀ y : ℝ, V y = w y)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ y : ℝ,
      V y = if y ≤ C.toReal then w y
        else w C.toReal + (y - C.toReal))
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hD : IsAdmissibleLe X x C D)
    (ω : Ω) (A : Set ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ s : A, (s : ℝ) ∈ paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω)) :
    (∑' s : A, ENNReal.ofReal
      (Real.exp (-(q * (s : ℝ))) *
        ((rightLimit D ((s : ℝ).toNNReal) ω -
            D ((s : ℝ).toNNReal) ω) +
          V (riskProcess X x D ((s : ℝ).toNNReal) ω -
            (rightLimit D ((s : ℝ).toNNReal) ω -
              D ((s : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)) -
          V (riskProcess X x D ((s : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)))) = 0 := by
  have hz : (fun s : A => ENNReal.ofReal
      (Real.exp (-(q * (s : ℝ))) *
        ((rightLimit D ((s : ℝ).toNNReal) ω -
            D ((s : ℝ).toNNReal) ω) +
          V (riskProcess X x D ((s : ℝ).toNNReal) ω -
            (rightLimit D ((s : ℝ).toNNReal) ω -
              D ((s : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)) -
          V (riskProcess X x D ((s : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)))) =
      (fun _ => (0 : ℝ≥0∞)) := by
    funext s
    have hs := hA s
    change (s : ℝ) ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ) ∩
      ({0} ∪ {t : ℝ | ENNReal.ofReal t < ruinTime X x D ω}) at hs
    have hPre : ((s : ℝ).toNNReal) = 0 ∨
        (((s : ℝ).toNNReal) : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω := by
      rcases hs.2 with hzero | hlt
      · left
        have heq : (s : ℝ) = 0 := by simpa using hzero
        simp only [heq, Real.toNNReal_zero]
      · right
        change (((s : ℝ).toNNReal) : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω at hlt
        exact hlt
    have hsign := avram_wave6_04b_allcap_actual_right_payment_secant_nonpos
      X x C hC w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVtop hVfinite
      D hD ω ((s : ℝ).toNNReal) hPre
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr
      (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Real.exp_pos _).le hsign)
  simpa [hz]

title: Original dividend time-zero Stieltjes atom signed correction at arbitrary positive cap
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_positive_cap_original_discounted_cell_signed_nonpos
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_positive_cap_original_global_closed_stieltjes_budget
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_closed_horizon_real_stieltjes_partition_finite
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_dividendStrategy_le_rightLimit

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal BigOperators
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- Real signed control of the actual time-zero dividend atom uniformly at all positive caps. -/
theorem solution
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {z : ℝ | 0 < z ∧ ENNReal.ofReal z < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
      ENNReal.ofReal z < C → 1 ≤ deriv w z)
    (hVtop : C = ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ, V z = w z)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ,
      V z = if z ≤ C.toReal then w z
        else w C.toReal + (z - C.toReal))
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hD : IsAdmissibleLe X x C D)
    (ω : Ω) :
    (∫⁻ s in ({0} : Set ℝ),
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * s))) ∂(dividendMeasure D ω)).toReal +
      (V (x + X.X 0 ω - rightLimit D 0 ω) - V (x + X.X 0 ω)) ≤ 0 := by
  have hAdmissible : IsAdmissible X x D := hD.1
  have hStrategy : IsDividendStrategy 𝓕 D := hAdmissible.1
  have hZeroJump := hAdmissible.2 ω (0 : ℝ≥0) (Or.inl rfl)
  have hCover0 : rightLimit D 0 ω ≤ x + X.X 0 ω := by
    dsimp [riskProcess] at hZeroJump
    linarith only [hZeroJump]
  have hD0nonneg : 0 ≤ D 0 ω := by
    have hm := hStrategy.2.1 ω
      (show (0 : ℝ≥0) ≤ (0 : ℝ≥0) from zero_le)
    simpa only [hStrategy.1 ω] using hm
  have hRight0nonneg : 0 ≤ rightLimit D 0 ω := le_trans hD0nonneg
    (dividendStrategy_le_rightLimit D hStrategy ω 0)
  have hOrder0 : x + X.X 0 ω - rightLimit D 0 ω ≤ x + X.X 0 ω := by
    linarith only [hRight0nonneg]
  have hSec0 := avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant
    C hC w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVtop hVfinite
    (x + X.X 0 ω - rightLimit D 0 ω) (x + X.X 0 ω)
    (sub_nonneg.mpr hCover0) hOrder0
  have hDrop0 : 0 ≤
      V (x + X.X 0 ω) - V (x + X.X 0 ω - rightLimit D 0 ω) := by
    linarith only [hSec0, hRight0nonneg]
  have hAtom := avram_wave5_04b_positive_cap_original_global_closed_stieltjes_budget
    X x C hC q hq w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVtop hVfinite
    D hD ω 0 (Or.inl rfl)
  have hAtomReal := ENNReal.toReal_mono (by simp) hAtom
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hDrop0] at hAtomReal
  simp only [Icc_self] at hAtomReal
  linarith only [hAtomReal]

title: Countable complete actual dividend-measure stopped atoms with zero chronological right-jump positive parts
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_actual_dividend_atomic_atomless_full_stieltjes_lintegral_split
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_real_clock_countable_right_positive_part_zero

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal BigOperators
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- On the actual finite-horizon dividend measure, the ruin-stopped
right-payment atoms have countable full support, including t=0, and every
chronological original-w right-jump positive-part correction vanishes. -/
theorem solution
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕) (x : ℝ)
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hD : IsDividendStrategy 𝓕 D)
    (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ω : Ω) (T : ℝ≥0) (q : ℝ)
    (hjump : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      (t = 0 ∨ (t : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω) →
      rightLimit D t ω - D t ω ≤
        w (riskProcess X x D t ω) -
          w (riskProcess X x D t ω -
            (rightLimit D t ω - D t ω))) :
    let μ : Measure ℝ :=
      (dividendMeasure D ω).restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ))
    ∃ (A : Set ℝ),
      A.Countable ∧
      A ⊆ paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω) ∩ Iic (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, t ∈ paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω) ∩ Iic (T : ℝ) →
        μ {t} ≠ 0 → t ∈ A) ∧
      (∑' t : A, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * (t : ℝ))) *
        ((rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω -
            D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω) +
          w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω -
            (rightLimit D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω -
              D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)) -
          w (riskProcess X x D ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) ω)))) = 0 := by
  dsimp only
  rcases avram_wave5_04b_actual_dividend_atomic_atomless_full_stieltjes_lintegral_split
      X x D hD ω T (fun _ => 0) with
    ⟨A₀, μatom, μdiffuse, hCount, hMeas, hSplit, hSum,
      hSupport, hNull, hSingle, hIntegral⟩
  let μ : Measure ℝ :=
    (dividendMeasure D ω).restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ))
  let A : Set ℝ :=
    A₀ ∩ (paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω) ∩ Iic (T : ℝ))
  have hCountA : A.Countable := hCount.mono (by
    intro t ht
    exact ht.1)
  have hSubset : A ⊆
      paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω) ∩ Iic (T : ℝ) := by
    intro t ht
    exact ht.2
  have hAllAtoms : ∀ t : ℝ,
      t ∈ paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω) ∩ Iic (T : ℝ) →
      μ {t} ≠ 0 → t ∈ A := by
    intro t ht hnonzero
    have htA₀ : t ∈ A₀ := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hSub : ({t} : Set ℝ) ⊆ A₀ᶜ := by
        intro s hs
        have heq : s = t := by simpa using hs
        subst s
        simpa using hnot
      have hAtomZero : μatom {t} = 0 := by
        apply le_antisymm
        · exact (measure_mono hSub).trans_eq hSupport
        · exact zero_le
      letI : NullSingletonClass μdiffuse := hNull
      have hDiffuseZero : μdiffuse {t} = 0 := measure_singleton t
      have hZero : μ {t} = 0 := by
        rw [hSplit, Measure.add_apply, hAtomZero, hDiffuseZero]
        simp
      exact hnonzero hZero
    exact ⟨htA₀, ht⟩
  have hNonneg : ∀ t : A, 0 ≤ (t : ℝ) := by
    intro t
    have htPay := (t.property).2.1
    change (t : ℝ) ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ) ∩
      ({0} ∪ {s : ℝ | ENNReal.ofReal s < ruinTime X x D ω}) at htPay
    exact htPay.1
  have hA : ∀ t : A,
      ((t : ℝ).toNNReal) = 0 ∨
        (((t : ℝ).toNNReal) : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω := by
    intro t
    have htPay := (t.property).2.1
    change (t : ℝ) ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ) ∩
      ({0} ∪ {s : ℝ | ENNReal.ofReal s < ruinTime X x D ω}) at htPay
    rcases htPay.2 with hzero | hlt
    · left
      have heq : (t : ℝ) = 0 := by simpa using hzero
      simp only [heq, Real.toNNReal_zero]
    · right
      change (((t : ℝ).toNNReal) : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω at hlt
      exact hlt
  refine ⟨A, hCountA, hSubset, hAllAtoms, ?_⟩
  exact avram_wave5_04b_real_clock_countable_right_positive_part_zero
    X x D w ω q hjump A hCountA hNonneg hA

title: Global ruin-stopped source-specific signed Stieltjes forward secant without hloc
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_paymentTimes_measurable

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- The actual signed dividend-control correction is nonpositive on the
ruin-stopped original reward domain for any deterministic horizon, including
t=0, cap/zero contacts, and singular-continuous dividend variation. -/
theorem solution
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C)
    (q δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {z : ℝ | 0 < z ∧ ENNReal.ofReal z < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
      ENNReal.ofReal z < C → 1 ≤ deriv w z)
    (hVtop : C = ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ, V z = w z)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ,
      V z = if z ≤ C.toReal then w z
        else w C.toReal + (z - C.toReal))
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hD : IsAdmissibleLe X x C D)
    (ω : Ω) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hIntegrable : IntegrableOn (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) - V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)))
      (paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω) ∩ Iic T) (dividendMeasure D ω)) :
    (∫ s in paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω) ∩ Iic T,
      Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) - V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)) ∂(dividendMeasure D ω)) ≤ 0 := by
  have hPoint : ∀ s : ℝ, s ∈ paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω) ∩ Iic T →
      Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) - V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)) ≤ 0 := by
    intro s hs
    have hsPay := hs.1
    change s ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ) ∩
      ({0} ∪ {t : ℝ | ENNReal.ofReal t < ruinTime X x D ω}) at hsPay
    have hPreS : s.toNNReal = 0 ∨
        (s.toNNReal : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω := by
      rcases hsPay.2 with hzero | hlt
      · left
        have heq : s = 0 := by simpa using hzero
        simp only [heq, Real.toNNReal_zero]
      · right
        change (s.toNNReal : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω at hlt
        exact hlt
    have hAdmissible : IsAdmissible X x D := hD.1
    have hCover := hAdmissible.2 ω s.toNNReal hPreS
    dsimp [riskProcess] at hCover
    let y : ℝ := x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω
    have hy : 0 ≤ y := by linarith only [hCover]
    have hOrder : y ≤ y + δ := le_add_of_nonneg_right hδ.le
    have hSec := avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant
      C hC w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVtop hVfinite
      y (y + δ) hy hOrder
    have hResidual : δ + V y - V (y + δ) ≤ 0 := by
      linarith only [hSec]
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Real.exp_pos _).le hResidual
  apply MeasureTheory.integral_nonpos_of_ae
  filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem
    (MeasurableSet.inter (paymentTimes_measurable _) measurableSet_Iic)] with s hs
  exact hPoint s hs

title: Direct original admissible closed-cap actual dividendMeasure signed forward correction without hloc
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_solvent_actual_stieltjes_forward_secant_real_signed_nonpos

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal

open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- For genuinely admissible original source-X dividends, the actual real
Stieltjes signed forward-secant correction is nonpositive on the full closed
horizon, including boundary contacts and singular-continuous variation. -/
theorem solution
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C)
    (q δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {z : ℝ | 0 < z ∧ ENNReal.ofReal z < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
      ENNReal.ofReal z < C → 1 ≤ deriv w z)
    (hVtop : C = ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ, V z = w z)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ,
      V z = if z ≤ C.toReal then w z
        else w C.toReal + (z - C.toReal))
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hD : IsAdmissibleLe X x C D)
    (ω : Ω) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (hPre : T = 0 ∨ (T : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω)
    (hIntegrable : IntegrableOn (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) - V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)))
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ)) (dividendMeasure D ω)) :
    (∫ s in Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ),
      Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) - V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)) ∂(dividendMeasure D ω)) ≤ 0 := by
  have hSolvent : ∀ s : ℝ, s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ) →
      0 ≤ x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω := by
    intro s hs
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := hs.1
    have hsT : s ≤ (T : ℝ) := hs.2
    have hrepr : (s.toNNReal : ℝ) = s := Real.coe_toNNReal s hs0
    have hleReal : (s.toNNReal : ℝ) ≤ (T : ℝ) := by
      simpa only [hrepr] using hsT
    have hle : s.toNNReal ≤ T := by
      exact_mod_cast hleReal
    have hPreS : s.toNNReal = 0 ∨
        (s.toNNReal : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω := by
      rcases hPre with hTzero | hTlt
      · left
        apply le_antisymm
        · simpa only [hTzero] using hle
        · exact zero_le
      · right
        have hcoe : (s.toNNReal : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (T : ℝ≥0∞) := by
          exact_mod_cast hle
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt hcoe hTlt
    have hAdmissible : IsAdmissible X x D := hD.1
    have hCover := hAdmissible.2 ω s.toNNReal hPreS
    dsimp [riskProcess] at hCover
    linarith only [hCover]
  exact avram_wave5_04b_solvent_actual_stieltjes_forward_secant_real_signed_nonpos
    X x C hC q δ hδ w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVtop hVfinite
    D ω T hSolvent hIntegrable

title: Actual original real-clock Stieltjes forward-secant correction is measurable
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave6_04b_original_real_clock_postpayment_reserve_measurable

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- The genuine original-source post-payment real-clock forward
secant integrand is Borel measurable whenever the extension V is Borel. -/
theorem AvramDividend.Classical.avram_wave6_04b_original_real_clock_forward_secant_measurable
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hD : IsDividendStrategy 𝓕 D)
    (ω : Ω) (q δ : ℝ) (V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hVmeas : Measurable V) :
    Measurable (fun s : ℝ =>
      Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) -
          V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ))) := by
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun s =>
    x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω
  have hF : Measurable F :=
    avram_wave6_04b_original_real_clock_postpayment_reserve_measurable
      X x D hD ω
  have hExp : Measurable (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-(q * s))) :=
    Real.continuous_exp.measurable.comp
      ((measurable_const.mul measurable_id).neg)
  have hVf : Measurable (fun s : ℝ => V (F s)) :=
    hVmeas.comp hF
  have hVfd : Measurable (fun s : ℝ => V (F s + δ)) :=
    hVmeas.comp (hF.add measurable_const)
  change Measurable (fun s : ℝ =>

title: Actual dividend measure has zero positive boundary forward-secant correction
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal

open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- The true dividend Stieltjes measure cannot charge a positive part of the globally
closed-cap forward secant correction. This includes diffuse and singular-continuous
variation and the time-zero atom, without a derivative at either cap endpoint. -/
theorem solution
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C)
    (q δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {z : ℝ | 0 < z ∧ ENNReal.ofReal z < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
      ENNReal.ofReal z < C → 1 ≤ deriv w z)
    (hVtop : C = ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ, V z = w z)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ,
      V z = if z ≤ C.toReal then w z
        else w C.toReal + (z - C.toReal))
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (ω : Ω) (T : ℝ≥0) :
    (∫⁻ s in Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ),
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ +
          V (max 0 (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω)) -
          V (max 0 (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)))
      ∂(dividendMeasure D ω)) = 0 := by
  have hPoint : ∀ s : ℝ,
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ +
          V (max 0 (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω)) -
          V (max 0 (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ))) = 0 := by
    intro s
    let y : ℝ := max 0 (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω)
    have hy : 0 ≤ y := le_max_left _ _
    have hOrder : y ≤ y + δ := le_add_of_nonneg_right hδ.le
    have hSec := avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant
      C hC w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVtop hVfinite
      y (y + δ) hy hOrder
    have hResidual : δ + V y - V (y + δ) ≤ 0 := by
      linarith only [hSec]
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Real.exp_pos _).le hResidual
  have hEq : (fun s : ℝ =>
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ +
          V (max 0 (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω)) -
          V (max 0 (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)))) =
      (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ≥0∞)) := funext hPoint
  simp only [hEq]
  simp

title: Finite-cap uniform bound on global derivative-free dividend secant residual
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- A finite cap bounds the entire incremental dividend-control secant
residual uniformly on nonnegative reserves, with no boundary derivative. -/
theorem solution
    (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C) (hCfinite : C ≠ ⊤)
    (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {z : ℝ | 0 < z ∧ ENNReal.ofReal z < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
      ENNReal.ofReal z < C → 1 ≤ deriv w z)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ,
      V z = if z ≤ C.toReal then w z
        else w C.toReal + (z - C.toReal))
    (y δ : ℝ) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    0 ≤ V (y + δ) - V y - δ ∧
      V (y + δ) - V y - δ ≤
        (w C.toReal - C.toReal) - w 0 := by
  have hVtop : C = ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ, V z = w z := by
    intro h
    exact (hCfinite h).elim
  have hC0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ C.toReal := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have hV0 : V 0 = w 0 := by
    simpa [hC0] using (hVfinite hCfinite 0)
  have hVC : V C.toReal = w C.toReal := by
    simpa using (hVfinite hCfinite C.toReal)
  have hOrder : y ≤ y + δ := le_add_of_nonneg_right hδ
  have hSecZero := avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant
    C hC w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVtop hVfinite
    0 y (le_refl (0 : ℝ)) hy
  have hSecStep := avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant
    C hC w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVtop hVfinite
    y (y + δ) hy hOrder
  have hLower : w 0 ≤ V y - y := by
    linarith only [hSecZero, hV0]
  have hUpper : V (y + δ) - (y + δ) ≤
      w C.toReal - C.toReal := by
    by_cases hBelow : y + δ ≤ C.toReal
    · have hSecCap := avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant
        C hC w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVtop hVfinite
        (y + δ) C.toReal (by linarith only [hy, hδ]) hBelow
      linarith only [hSecCap, hVC]
    · have hAbove : ¬ y + δ ≤ C.toReal := hBelow
      have hVAbove : V (y + δ) =
          w C.toReal + ((y + δ) - C.toReal) := by
        simpa [hAbove] using (hVfinite hCfinite (y + δ))
      linarith only [hVAbove]
  constructor
  · linarith only [hSecStep]
  · linarith only [hLower, hUpper]

title: Joint global Stieltjes and countable w-right-jump signed dividend correction without hloc
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_positive_cap_original_global_closed_horizon_real_signed_nonpos
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_original_countable_right_payment_real_signed_sum_nonpos

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal BigOperators
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- Joint signed control of the complete actual closed-horizon Stieltjes mass and the absolutely summable countable explicit-w right-payment correction, with no reserve-interior localisation. -/
theorem solution
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {z : ℝ | 0 < z ∧ ENNReal.ofReal z < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
      ENNReal.ofReal z < C → 1 ≤ deriv w z)
    (hVtop : C = ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ, V z = w z)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ,
      V z = if z ≤ C.toReal then w z
        else w C.toReal + (z - C.toReal))
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hD : IsAdmissibleLe X x C D)
    (ω : Ω) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (hPre : T = 0 ∨ (T : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω)
    (hjump : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      (t = 0 ∨ (t : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω) →
      rightLimit D t ω - D t ω ≤
        w (riskProcess X x D t ω) -
          w (riskProcess X x D t ω -
            (rightLimit D t ω - D t ω)))
    (A : Set ℝ≥0) (hCount : A.Countable)
    (hA : ∀ t : A,
      (t : ℝ≥0) = 0 ∨
        ((t : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω)
    (hSummable : Summable (fun t : A => Real.exp (-(q * ((t : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))) *
      ((rightLimit D (t : ℝ≥0) ω - D (t : ℝ≥0) ω) +
        w (riskProcess X x D (t : ℝ≥0) ω -
          (rightLimit D (t : ℝ≥0) ω - D (t : ℝ≥0) ω)) -
        w (riskProcess X x D (t : ℝ≥0) ω)))) :
    ((∫⁻ s in Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ),
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * s))) ∂(dividendMeasure D ω)).toReal +
      (V (x + X.X T ω - rightLimit D T ω) -
        V (x + X.X T ω))) +
    (∑' t : A, Real.exp (-(q * ((t : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))) *
      ((rightLimit D (t : ℝ≥0) ω - D (t : ℝ≥0) ω) +
        w (riskProcess X x D (t : ℝ≥0) ω -
          (rightLimit D (t : ℝ≥0) ω - D (t : ℝ≥0) ω)) -
        w (riskProcess X x D (t : ℝ≥0) ω))) ≤ 0 := by
  have hContinuous := avram_wave5_04b_positive_cap_original_global_closed_horizon_real_signed_nonpos
    X x C hC q hq w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVtop hVfinite
    D hD ω T hPre
  have hRightJumps := avram_wave5_04b_original_countable_right_payment_real_signed_sum_nonpos
    X x D w ω q hjump A hCount hA hSummable
  linarith only [hContinuous, hRightJumps]
