title: Full original stopped closed-window postpayment solvency including zero and cap
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- Genuine postpayment solvency holds throughout every original pre-ruin closed
time window, including time zero and boundary reserve zero/cap contacts. -/
theorem solution
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞)
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hD : IsAdmissibleLe X x C D)
    (ω : Ω) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (hPre : T = 0 ∨ (T : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω) :
    ∀ s : ℝ, s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ) →
      0 ≤ x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω := by
  intro s hs
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := hs.1
  have hsT : s ≤ (T : ℝ) := hs.2
  have hrepr : (s.toNNReal : ℝ) = s := Real.coe_toNNReal hs0
  have hleReal : (s.toNNReal : ℝ) ≤ (T : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [hrepr] using hsT
  have hle : s.toNNReal ≤ T := by
    exact_mod_cast hleReal
  have hPreS : s.toNNReal = 0 ∨
      (s.toNNReal : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω := by
    rcases hPre with hTzero | hTlt
    · left
      apply le_antisymm
      · simpa only [hTzero] using hle
      · exact zero_le _
    · right
      have hcoe : (s.toNNReal : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (T : ℝ≥0∞) := by
        exact_mod_cast hle
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hcoe hTlt
  have hAdmissible : IsAdmissible X x D := hD.1
  have hCover := hAdmissible.2 ω s.toNNReal hPreS
  dsimp [riskProcess] at hCover
  linarith only [hCover]

title: Actual integral signed derivative-free cap-contact Stieltjes forward-secant control
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal

open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- The true dividend Stieltjes measure has a nonpositive integrable real signed
forward-secant correction, including diffuse, singular-continuous and time-zero
variation, without differentiating the candidate at either cap endpoint. -/
theorem solution
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C)
    (q δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {z : ℝ | 0 < z ∧ ENNReal.ofReal z < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
      ENNReal.ofReal z < C → 1 ≤ deriv w z)
    (hVtop : C = ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ, V z = w z)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ,
      V z = if z ≤ C.toReal then w z
        else w C.toReal + (z - C.toReal))
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (ω : Ω) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (hIntegrable : IntegrableOn (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ +
          V (max 0 (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω)) -
          V (max 0 (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)))
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ)) (dividendMeasure D ω)) :
    (∫ s in Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ),
      Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ +
          V (max 0 (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω)) -
          V (max 0 (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)) ∂(dividendMeasure D ω)) ≤ 0 := by
  have hPoint : ∀ s : ℝ, Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ +
          V (max 0 (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω)) -
          V (max 0 (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)) ≤ 0 := by
    intro s
    let y : ℝ := max 0 (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω)
    have hy : 0 ≤ y := le_max_left _ _
    have hOrder : y ≤ y + δ := le_add_of_nonneg_right hδ.le
    have hSec := avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant
      C hC w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVtop hVfinite
      y (y + δ) hy hOrder
    have hResidual : δ + V y - V (y + δ) ≤ 0 := by
      linarith only [hSec]
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Real.exp_pos _).le hResidual
  exact MeasureTheory.integral_nonpos_of_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hPoint)

title: Ruin-stopped actual dividendMeasure forward secant positive-part integral zero without integrability
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_paymentTimes_measurable

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- The positive part of the signed Stieltjes forward-secant control vanishes
on the full original ruin-stopped payment domain with no integrability premise;
time zero, boundary contacts and singular-continuous variation are retained. -/
theorem solution
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C)
    (q δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {z : ℝ | 0 < z ∧ ENNReal.ofReal z < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
      ENNReal.ofReal z < C → 1 ≤ deriv w z)
    (hVtop : C = ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ, V z = w z)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ,
      V z = if z ≤ C.toReal then w z
        else w C.toReal + (z - C.toReal))
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hD : IsAdmissibleLe X x C D)
    (ω : Ω) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    : (∫⁻ s in paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω) ∩ Iic T,
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) -
          V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ))) ∂(dividendMeasure D ω)) = 0 := by
  have hPoint : ∀ s : ℝ, s ∈ paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω) ∩ Iic T →
      Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) - V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)) ≤ 0 := by
    intro s hs
    have hsPay := hs.1
    change s ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ) ∩
      ({0} ∪ {t : ℝ | ENNReal.ofReal t < ruinTime X x D ω}) at hsPay
    have hPreS : s.toNNReal = 0 ∨
        (s.toNNReal : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω := by
      rcases hsPay.2 with hzero | hlt
      · left
        have heq : s = 0 := by simpa using hzero
        simp only [heq, Real.toNNReal_zero]
      · right
        change (s.toNNReal : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω at hlt
        exact hlt
    have hAdmissible : IsAdmissible X x D := hD.1
    have hCover := hAdmissible.2 ω s.toNNReal hPreS
    dsimp [riskProcess] at hCover
    let y : ℝ := x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω
    have hy : 0 ≤ y := by linarith only [hCover]
    have hOrder : y ≤ y + δ := le_add_of_nonneg_right hδ.le
    have hSec := avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant
      C hC w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVtop hVfinite
      y (y + δ) hy hOrder
    have hResidual : δ + V y - V (y + δ) ≤ 0 := by
      linarith only [hSec]
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Real.exp_pos _).le hResidual
  have hTerm : ∀ s : ℝ,
      s ∈ paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω) ∩ Iic T →
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) -
          V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ))) = 0 := by
    intro s hs
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr (hPoint s hs)
  calc
    (∫⁻ s in paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω) ∩ Iic T,
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) -
          V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ))) ∂(dividendMeasure D ω))
      = (∫⁻ s in paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω) ∩ Iic T,
          (0 : ℝ≥0∞) ∂(dividendMeasure D ω)) := by
            apply MeasureTheory.lintegral_congr_ae
            filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem
              (MeasurableSet.inter (paymentTimes_measurable _) measurableSet_Iic)] with s hs
            exact hTerm s hs
    _ = 0 := by simp

title: All-positive-cap actual chronological right dividend payment nonpositive secant
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_dividendStrategy_le_rightLimit

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- Actual chronological right dividend payment correction is nonpositive
for every positive finite/infinite cap, including zero and cap contacts. -/
theorem AvramDividend.Classical.avram_wave6_04b_allcap_actual_right_payment_secant_nonpos
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C)
    (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {y : ℝ | 0 < y ∧ ENNReal.ofReal y < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y →
      ENNReal.ofReal y < C → 1 ≤ deriv w y)
    (hVtop : C = ⊤ → ∀ y : ℝ, V y = w y)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ y : ℝ,
      V y = if y ≤ C.toReal then w y
        else w C.toReal + (y - C.toReal))
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hD : IsAdmissibleLe X x C D)
    (ω : Ω) (t : ℝ≥0)
    (hPre : t = 0 ∨ (t : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω) :
    (rightLimit D t ω - D t ω) +
      V (riskProcess X x D t ω -
        (rightLimit D t ω - D t ω)) -
      V (riskProcess X x D t ω) ≤ 0 := by
  have hAdmissible : IsAdmissible X x D := hD.1
  have hStrategy : IsDividendStrategy 𝓕 D := hAdmissible.1
  let U : ℝ := riskProcess X x D t ω
  let δ : ℝ := rightLimit D t ω - D t ω
  have hpay : 0 ≤ δ := sub_nonneg.mpr
    (dividendStrategy_le_rightLimit D hStrategy ω t)
  have hpost : 0 ≤ U - δ := by
    have hs := hAdmissible.2 ω t hPre
    change δ ≤ U at hs
    linarith only [hs]
  have horder : U - δ ≤ U := by linarith only [hpay]
  have hsec := avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant
    C hC w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVtop hVfinite
    (U - δ) U hpost horder
  change δ + V (U - δ) - V U ≤ 0
  linarith only [hsec]

title: Closed finite-cap actual signed dividend Stieltjes correction integrable, automatic potential and time measurability
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave6_04b_finite_cap_actual_stopped_secant_integrable
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave6_04b_cap_extension_measurable_of_zero_negative

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- Finite-cap actual stopped signed dividend Stieltjes correction is
integrable without additional measurability hypotheses: the zero-negative
continuous candidate has a measurable cap-linear extension. -/
theorem AvramDividend.Classical.avram_wave6_04b_finite_cap_actual_stopped_secant_integrable_closed
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C) (hCfinite : C ≠ ⊤)
    (q δ : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {z : ℝ | 0 < z ∧ ENNReal.ofReal z < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
      ENNReal.ofReal z < C → 1 ≤ deriv w z)
    (hw_neg : ∀ y : ℝ, y < 0 → w y = 0)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ,
      V z = if z ≤ C.toReal then w z
        else w C.toReal + (z - C.toReal))
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hD : IsAdmissibleLe X x C D)
    (ω : Ω) (T : ℝ≥0) :
    IntegrableOn (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
      (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) -
        V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)))
      (paymentTimes (ruinTime X x D ω) ∩ Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ))
      (dividendMeasure D ω) := by
  have hVmeas : Measurable V :=
    avram_wave6_04b_cap_extension_measurable_of_zero_negative
      w V C hw_cont hw_neg
      (fun htop => (hCfinite htop).elim) hVfinite
  exact avram_wave6_04b_finite_cap_actual_stopped_secant_integrable
    X x C hC hCfinite q δ hq hδ w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad
    hVmeas hVfinite D hD ω T

title: Unclipped original solvent reserve actual Stieltjes real signed boundary secant integral
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy
import Theorems.Thm_AvramDividend_Classical_avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal

open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- At genuinely solvent original source-X postpayment states, the actual real
Stieltjes signed forward-secant correction is nonpositive on the full closed
horizon, including boundary contacts and singular-continuous variation. -/
theorem solution
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕)
    (x : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (hC : 0 < C)
    (q δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (w V : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw_cont : ContinuousOn w (Ici 0))
    (hw_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w
      {z : ℝ | 0 < z ∧ ENNReal.ofReal z < C})
    (hw_grad : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
      ENNReal.ofReal z < C → 1 ≤ deriv w z)
    (hVtop : C = ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ, V z = w z)
    (hVfinite : C ≠ ⊤ → ∀ z : ℝ,
      V z = if z ≤ C.toReal then w z
        else w C.toReal + (z - C.toReal))
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (ω : Ω) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (hSolvent : ∀ s : ℝ, s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ) →
      0 ≤ x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω)
    (hIntegrable : IntegrableOn (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) - V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)))
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ)) (dividendMeasure D ω)) :
    (∫ s in Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ),
      Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) - V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)) ∂(dividendMeasure D ω)) ≤ 0 := by
  have hPoint : ∀ s : ℝ, s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ) →
      Real.exp (-(q * s)) *
        (δ + V (x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) - V ((x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω) + δ)) ≤ 0 := by
    intro s hs
    let y : ℝ := x + X.X s.toNNReal ω - rightLimit D s.toNNReal ω
    have hy : 0 ≤ y := hSolvent s hs
    have hOrder : y ≤ y + δ := le_add_of_nonneg_right hδ.le
    have hSec := avram_wave5_04b_positive_ennreal_cap_extension_global_secant
      C hC w V hw_cont hw_smooth hw_grad hVtop hVfinite
      y (y + δ) hy hOrder
    have hResidual : δ + V y - V (y + δ) ≤ 0 := by
      linarith only [hSec]
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Real.exp_pos _).le hResidual
  apply MeasureTheory.integral_nonpos_of_ae
  filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with s hs
  exact hPoint s hs

title: Every nonzero actual original right dividend payment time on a closed horizon is countable, including time zero and horizon endpoint
author: @WillR
source: Apply the canonical original Stieltjes countable-support completeness theorem with unit weight. Every actual strictly positive right-payment δ_t at t≤T has a strictly positive original singleton measure mass by its exact atom identity, hence its physical-time cast lies in the support A. The embedding ℝ≥0→ℝ is injective, so the preimage of the countable set A is countable; take the subset of all actual positive right payments. This is a genuine arbitrary-finite-variation countability result, not a finite-jump assumption.

title: Original countable absolutely summable right-payment real correction without hloc
author: @WillR
source:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_SpectrallyNegativeLevy
import Definitions.Def_AvramDividend_Classical_DividendStrategy

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal BigOperators
open AvramDividend.Classical

set_option pp.explicit true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.universes true

/-- The complete absolutely summable countable chronological right-payment signed correction is nonpositive at every boundary and at time zero. -/
theorem solution
    {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    (X : SpectrallyNegativeLevy P 𝓕) (x : ℝ)
    (D : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ω : Ω) (q : ℝ)
    (hjump : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      (t = 0 ∨ (t : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω) →
      rightLimit D t ω - D t ω ≤
        w (riskProcess X x D t ω) -
          w (riskProcess X x D t ω -
            (rightLimit D t ω - D t ω)))
    (A : Set ℝ≥0) (hCount : A.Countable)
    (hA : ∀ t : A,
      (t : ℝ≥0) = 0 ∨
        ((t : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) < ruinTime X x D ω)
    (hSummable : Summable (fun t : A => Real.exp (-(q * ((t : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))) *
      ((rightLimit D (t : ℝ≥0) ω - D (t : ℝ≥0) ω) +
        w (riskProcess X x D (t : ℝ≥0) ω -
          (rightLimit D (t : ℝ≥0) ω - D (t : ℝ≥0) ω)) -
        w (riskProcess X x D (t : ℝ≥0) ω)))) :
    (∑' t : A, Real.exp (-(q * ((t : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))) *
      ((rightLimit D (t : ℝ≥0) ω - D (t : ℝ≥0) ω) +
        w (riskProcess X x D (t : ℝ≥0) ω -
          (rightLimit D (t : ℝ≥0) ω - D (t : ℝ≥0) ω)) -
        w (riskProcess X x D (t : ℝ≥0) ω))) ≤ 0 := by
  apply tsum_nonpos
  intro t
  have hDrop := hjump (t : ℝ≥0) (hA t)
  have hResidual :
      (rightLimit D (t : ℝ≥0) ω - D (t : ℝ≥0) ω) +
        w (riskProcess X x D (t : ℝ≥0) ω -
          (rightLimit D (t : ℝ≥0) ω - D (t : ℝ≥0) ω)) -
        w (riskProcess X x D (t : ℝ≥0) ω) ≤ 0 := by
    linarith only [hDrop]
  exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Real.exp_pos _).le hResidual
